thread:
taylor: Heads-up: during vuln triage someone exported ~10h of auth logs. That's larger than our intended windows. We need a fast patch to exporter/service default TTLs and KMS unwrap gating.
ravi: Yikes. Which exporter path?
taylor: presigned snapshot via export-service -> s3. CLI default flag was 24h.
morgan: Quick proposals: 1) change CLI and service default to 30m; 2) require ticket_id for any export >30m; 3) mint an ephemeral unwrap token for KMS decrypts with 10m TTL.
auditor-bot: DLP: export contained usernames and device IDs, created ticket SEC-701.
security-bot: Logged SEC-701 and attached export metadata.
oncall: I've revoked the presigned URL and rotated keys for that export. Short-term mitigation: make presigned URL TTL 5m and auto-revoke on DLP signal.
ravi: For RBAC, enforce OPA policy like: 
```
package exporter.auth
allow {
 input.requester in data.roles["forensics_analyst"]
 input.params.ttl <= 1800
}
```
Also require input.context.ticket_id when ttl > 1800.
morgan: Agree. Also add an approval boundary: <=30m auto-approved by service account; >30m requires an ENGSEC ticket id in request and a human approver.
taylor: KMS change: can we add requestContext.audit.ticket_id as a required condition in key policy or the envelope layer? We need unwrap CloudTrail entries to include ticket_id and token_id.
ravi: Key policy IAM conditions can check requestContext: we can require kms:RequestAlias or a session tag. We'll need to update the envelope code to pass a session tag like "ticket_id=ENGSEC-701".
oncall: I'll open TICKET-ENG-812 to track URL revocation, presign TTL, and runbook changes. I'll also add a runbook step to immediately revoke on DLP>0.6.
morgan: Streaming exports: tighten to 1h for triage and run a PII scrub stage before allowing raw PII fields.
auditor-bot: Recommend metric "export_requests_without_ticket" to alert on policy bypass attempts.
taylor: Action owners: morgan -> exporter config + streaming rules, ravi -> OPA policy PR, taylor -> envelope/session-tagging for KMS + key-policy draft, oncall -> ticket & runbook. I'll follow up with a 15-min sync at 09:45 UTC.
ravi: One more: add an automated DLP gate pre-export to call webhook://dlp-eval and block if score > 0.6. Saves human triage.
morgan: I'll wire the DLP webhook into the exporter and emit structured audit logs: {export_id, requester, ttl, ticket_id, dlp_score, token_id}.
taylor: Thanks  let's keep defaults conservative. I'll update SEC-701 with remediation notes and link PRs when ready. :thumbsup:
